query: Please implement an animated wordpress website with 8 pages. The website should have a home page, about us, services, products, news, contact us, FAQ, and login/registration pages. Users should be able to browse the website, view animations, and navigate to different pages. The website should have a responsive design to adapt to different devices and screen sizes. Assign antique white to body backgrounds and sienna to main components.
